dependency_graph.assessment: The graph resolves spookyhash 2.1.2 (requires-python >=3.9) but contains no dependency or reverse-dependency edges within the returned rows. That is an omission, not evidence of none: the checkout shows zero runtime dependencies, build requires setuptools>=77 and cython>=3.1, and optional test extras pytest, hypothesis, numpy (typing extras mypy, typing-extensions). No conflict with the graph. Audit against PyPI and RISE index: cython has RISE riscv64 wheels cp312-cp314 (3.2.9, 3.3.0) but none on public PyPI; numpy has RISE riscv64 wheels cp312-cp314t (2.5.2-2.5.3) and none on public PyPI latest; hypothesis has public riscv64 abi3 wheels (cp311-abi3) and RISE cp312-314t; mypy has RISE cp312-cp314t wheels, none public; pytest, setuptools, typing-extensions are pure-Python (py3-none-any) on public PyPI.

path_coverage.assessment: Add ubuntu-24.04-riscv to build_wheels matrix next to ubuntu-24.04-arm; cibuildwheel v4.3.5 builds manylinux_2_39 and musllinux_1_2 riscv64 natively. Build isolation needs Cython (no public riscv64 wheel; RISE index has cp312-cp314), so set PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.riseproject.dev/simple and PIP_PREFER_BINARY=true for the build/test environment, propagated into the container via CIBW_ENVIRONMENT (or CIBW_ENVIRONMENT_PASS_LINUX); uv would additionally need UV_EXTRA_INDEX_URL and UV_INDEX_STRATEGY settings.

Add ubuntu-24.04-riscv to the Test os matrix with an exclude for python 3.9 (reviewer request); numpy/hypothesis/mypy lack public riscv64 wheels so the paired PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL and PIP_PREFER_BINARY should be set at job/workflow env level in test.yml; CIBW_TEST_EXTRAS=test in wheels.yml consumes the same env.

upload_all downloads cibw-* artifacts (merge-multiple) gated on release published; the riscv row's artifact name cibw-wheels-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ strategy.job-index }} is unique and automatically included; no change expected beyond the matrix row.
pyproject.toml/setup.py/MANIFEST.in need no change: no architecture-specific build flags, markers or classifiers; Operating System :: OS Independent.
README and CONTRIBUTING contain no supported-architecture list; no documentation change is required.

src/SpookyV2.cpp and spookyhash.pyx contain no architecture-specific dispatch or riscv-sensitive code (grep for riscv/rv64 empty); SpookyHash handles alignment and endianness portably; no change required.

proposal.rationale: Pure portable C++/Cython extension with no external native dependencies or arch-specific code; upstream ships no riscv64 wheels while the RISE index already builds them. Upstream wheels.yml and test.yml use dedicated native runner rows per architecture (ubuntu-24.04-arm, windows-11-arm), so native ubuntu-24.04-riscv rows are the precedent (this supersedes the earlier QEMU idea). A workflow-only change is bounded; the owner merges matrix PRs without review (#11, #14) and CONTRIBUTING has no CLA/DCO.
proposal.release_coverage: PyPI 2.1.2: macOS x86_64/arm64, manylinux_2_28/musllinux_1_2 x86_64+aarch64, Windows win32/amd64/arm64; riscv64 absent.
proposal.release_graph: wheels.yml: build_wheels matrix + make_sdist -> upload_all (environment pypi, trusted publishing) on release published; triggers push main, PR, release, weekly cron. test.yml separate native tests.
proposal.risks: Native riscv runner availability/queue time on upstream (the runner label is provided by the RISE runner service and may not exist for owner's repository, which would leave jobs queued); numpy/mypy may build from source without the RISE index; owner's riscv64 intent unknown; wheels for cp310/cp311/3.15 are absent from the RISE index so dependencies fall back to sdist.
proposal.target_matrix: ubuntu-24.04-riscv native runner; CPython 3.10-3.15 incl. 3.14t/3.15t (3.9 excluded in Test); cibuildwheel defaults manylinux_2_39 and musllinux_1_2 riscv64

data.summary: Refresh dossier for spookyhash (buhanec/spookyhash, MIT, sole maintainer). Upstream PyPI 2.1.2 ships no riscv64 wheels; no riscv issue/PR exists upstream and no ecosystem report exists. Pure portable C++/Cython with no native deps. The existing dev PR adds native ubuntu-24.04-riscv rows to wheels.yml and test.yml, matching the upstream dedicated-native-runner precedent. Recommend develop, workflow-only, and add the paired RISE index/prefer-binary env for dependency wheels.
